scope: Payload IRQ entry/search with candidate continuation at its original address with synthetic caller-saved handler effects: checks IE acknowledgement/restoration, IRQ/System banked stacks/LRs, saved SPSR restoration, ARM/Thumb handler entry and final registers/flags. Game Pak cases halt without acknowledgement or handler call. Does not emulate hardware interrupt entry, BIOS epilogue, nested interrupts, IF write-one-to-clear hardware or real handlers.
